observation: A continuous strike crosses the entire first sentence, including 2. The second old Soit T has its own strike. The small parenthesized number before it is heavily retraced and remains uncertain; its state is not inferred from blackness alone. NB has a separate underline. Each T has a single roof and stem, with no independent overbar. The interval has closed square brackets at both ends. The descender of forment reaches the lower crop boundary, while its letter bodies remain visible.

The first croissante-like word has a compressed, raised ending, so its abbreviation remains uncertain. Both raised marks over T are visibly open loops and are represented as circles here. Each T has a single roof. The lower-right cluster after the second marked T is crossed/overwritten and only tentatively recoverable as lambda. The tall descending stroke beside the equals sign belongs to déf, not a separate formula symbol. The interval is open at zero and closed at one. The following Si clause along the bottom/right edge is neighbouring continuation and is excluded here.

Two separate, nearly parallel marginal strokes were counted twice. They are vertical in the original, slant slightly right downwards and have unequal lower endpoints; neither has an arrowhead or label. The saved crop was rotated clockwise for inspection, while the reading preserves their original vertical orientation.

The first topologique is raised with a curved leader to intérieur; the later top is a shorter raised insertion with an angular leader, and no independent abbreviation stop is secure there. No detached circumflex is visible over sur. The raised T marks are small open loops; the T roofs themselves are single strokes. The final T_1 is retraced but has no separate overbar. The sentence continues beyond the box after dans.

The first T_1=T is plain, with one roof per T. The marked T before sauf has an open raised loop and an overworked lower-right index; 1 is preferred, while a crossed lambda remains possible and its revision state is not secure. The lower marked T has a filled point rather than the open loop seen above. The empty-set-shaped glyph has a small loop and a long diagonal crossing stroke. Si has a large s and separate i dot, not a numbered condition. Slanted marginal writing intrudes at lower left and is excluded from the main sentence.

The two formulas share one opening brace. The parenthesized number is overtraced, with 6 the recoverable candidate. The old symbol after the first equality has two curved lower returns beneath a heavy cancellation and remains xi/E uncertain. Both live symbols visibly contain E followed by a smaller p with a long descender; the lower one has a separate point over E. The upper subscript reads 1-lambda-equals-epsilon and the superscripts are parenthesized T. The lower central U-shaped mark is heavily retraced but retains the geometry of a cup; it is not replaced by an expected set operation. A separate multiplication point follows the parenthesis. The upper T mark is an open loop; the bord and lower-formula T marks are filled points. Marginal diagonal writing at left is excluded.

NB has one underline. The first E has a densely retraced upper portion, leaving a possible extra bar unresolved; the later E is plain and neither prose occurrence has a secure small p. The formula below visibly uses Ep with a descending p. The isomorphism-like relation has a wavy upper stroke and straight lower stroke. A short underbrace lies only beneath 1-epsilon and is labelled lambda. Both interval brackets are closed. The T points are filled and their roofs single. No terminal stop follows the displayed formula.

The long margin was rotated clockwise in its single saved crop. NB has one underline. The dotted T is raised above the first compact phrase and linked by a curved leader. The connective before the following T compact remains unresolved, and a curved sign with a detached point at the end of that line may be a question mark. The right interval bracket is repeatedly traced and cannot securely distinguish open from closed. A crossed curled symbol follows forment. At the far end of the voisinages line, the old word begins with a tall f but its middle is struck; the smaller raised replacement is also uncertain. In the parenthesis, the ending of voisinages is overworked, and the last adjective can only be offered as absolus/ouverts. Upright main-text numbers, words and formulas visible along the lower rotated edge are excluded.

The numeral 2 has a complete surrounding circle with a short pen return at the right. The relation between Y and X is an open containment curve with no arrowhead or equality bar. One underline spans voisinage conique, while a separate shorter underline applies only to dans on the next line. The T has a single roof and no overbar. The sentence continues beyond this box.

The action connector is a horizontal shaft ending in a filled pen stop; no independent arrowhead branches are secure, so it remains headless. I is thin and the T letters have one roof each. The abbreviation after vois. has a descending final stroke, favouring top. over tub. Conique is raised with a curved leader, and (1) sits above that insertion. The old sentence beneath has one continuous strike; its final word/group is obscured enough to remain uncertain. Alors les is live to the right of the cancelled line.

The final small relation after T_lambda consists of two short dark marks, favouring equals but leaving a colon possible.
